searchText: Hey guys! Could you share your opinion whether withdrawals and 4844 forks can be timestamp based as by spec or you prefer to have them block number based for now(devnet3)? Let's find consensus I think we should use timestamp - is there any reason to use block number? Simpler for EL devs, but has a ton of bad side effects so we agreed to do timestamps
